limitations: This is a local desktop browser check, not ModelScope hosting, registration, public concept publication or final contest receipt.
One level autoplay/import, a third-level bridge/restore sequence and one isolated mutation were observed; no claim that all four levels or mobile layouts were tested in this browser session.
Planning and mutation search are deterministic BFS, not runtime LLM inference or DGX Spark usage.
The wrong-dock mutation is deliberately injected and isolated from normal gameplay, not a newly discovered production vulnerability.
Raw screenshots retain browser chrome and unrelated account context and are not published. Any later video must use separately reviewed cropped frames.
The fifteen still captures do not establish continuous recording; video completion or playback is not claimed here.
The November 6 Node-only evidence batch is preserved unchanged and is not retroactively described as browser verification.
Hashes identify bytes, not independent third-party signatures or attestation.
